articles.summary: Key Takeaways Function of Beauty's products are designed to support the unique needs of straight, wavy, curly, and coily hair types. Straight hair benefits from lightweight products that smooth and protect without weighing strands down. Wavy hair needs a balance of hydration, heat protection, and lightweight styling support to maintain definition. Curly hair often requires deeper conditioning because its spiral structure makes it harder for natural oils to travel down the hair shaft. Coily hair benefits from moisture-rich leave-in products that help hydrate, define, and support its naturally delicate structure. Understanding how your hair type affects oil distribution, moisture retention, and styling behavior can help you choose products that work with your hair's biology. More
